name: SiteSkyline Smart Sales – Frequently Bought Together, Bundles & Upsell for WooCommerce
author: Sky Plugins

sections.description:
SiteSkyline Smart Sales brings autonomous, multi-algorithm behavioral recommendation engines directly into your WooCommerce store — without external APIs, customer tracking bloat, or recurring SaaS fees.

Key Features

  • Frequently Bought Together (FBT): High-converting 1-click bundle purchase with real-time dynamic total calculations.
  • Customers Also Viewed: Markov chain transition matrices calculate sequential browsing tendencies across product views.
  • Compare With Similar Items: Automatic attribute and spec comparison table for competing products in identical categories.
  • Cart Cross-Sell Boost: Real-time basket affinity suggestions embedded right before checkout.
  • Post-Purchase Thank You Upsells: Immediate complementary product recommendations on the WooCommerce order received page.
  • Inspired by Your Browsing History: Multi-session personalized recommendation grids based on actual user engagement.
  • Recently Viewed Products: Instant-access carousel of previously inspected products.
  • Predictive Smart Search: Live AJAX search bar with instant keyword affinity and product matches.
  • Auto-Computed Product Badges: Amazon-style Trending, Best Seller, Rising, New & Popular, and Hot Right Now badges computed automatically from real sales velocity and behavioral signals.
  • Behavioral Social Proof Signals: Honest, data-backed signals such as “X bought in the last 30 days”, “X people viewed this today”, low-stock urgency, and category popularity.
  • Smart Free Shipping Progress Bar: Auto-detects your free shipping threshold from WooCommerce shipping zones and suggests a complementary product to reach it.
  • Smart “For You” Personalized Section: Session-based personalized product grid with an algorithmic trending fallback for new visitors.
  • Optimization Engine Control Center: Toggle individual recommendation algorithms directly from the admin dashboard with instant AJAX persistence.
  • 100% On-Site & Privacy-First Recommendation Engine: All algorithms execute entirely on your local WordPress database. No shopper or customer browsing data is ever transmitted to external servers.

External Services & Privacy

This plugin connects to external services provided by SiteSkyline (https://siteskyline.com) for administrative features:

  1. SiteSkyline Companion Plugin Catalog:

    • What it does: Fetches a curated catalog of verified companion plugins in the WordPress admin under the SiteSkyline Plugin Manager tab, allowing administrators to discover and install companion tools.
    • Service URL: https://support.siteskyline.com/api/plugin-catalog
    • Data Sent: Standard HTTP GET request. No store, user, customer, or browsing data is transmitted.
    • Terms of Service: https://siteskyline.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://siteskyline.com/privacy

  2. Diagnostic Telemetry & Deactivation Feedback (Opt-In Only):

    • What it does: Helps our engineering team detect PHP/WooCommerce compatibility issues, prevent plugin conflicts, and improve features based on deactivation reasons.
    • Service URL: https://siteskyline.com/wp-json/plugin-feedback/v1/submit
    • Data Sent: Sent only upon explicit administrator opt-in or voluntary submission of the deactivation dialog. Data includes anonymous environment details (WordPress version, WooCommerce version, PHP version, plugin version, site locale, active theme name, and optional feedback comments). Never transmits customer data, orders, or personal buyer information.
    • Terms of Service: https://siteskyline.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://siteskyline.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the siteskyline-smart-sales folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to SkyPlugins > Smart Sales in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure recommendation weights, enable desired optimization engines, and preview widgets on your store.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send customer or shopping data to third-party servers?

No. Every recommendation algorithm (Markov chains, Market Basket Analysis, Co-Cart probability, and Search Graphs) runs 100% locally inside your WordPress database. Zero customer browsing or checkout data is ever sent off-site.

Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes, SiteSkyline Smart Sales requires WooCommerce 5.0 or higher. It is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Cart & Checkout Blocks.

What external services does this plugin connect to?

This plugin connects to external services provided by SiteSkyline solely for administrative operations:
* Fetching the companion plugin catalog from https://support.siteskyline.com/api/plugin-catalog for the in-dashboard Plugin Manager.
* Sending anonymous diagnostic telemetry and deactivation feedback to https://siteskyline.com/wp-json/plugin-feedback/v1/submit only when explicitly permitted by the site administrator.

Where can I review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service?

  • Privacy Policy: https://siteskyline.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://siteskyline.com/terms
